title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: It's Showtime at the Apollo
description:

It's Showtime at the Apollo is a syndicated music television show, first broadcast on September 12, 1987. The show features live performances from both professional and up-and-coming artists, and also features the Amateur Night competition.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S2 E26 — Tim Conway, Melba Moore, Bing Crosby
The President (Conway) gets advice from his janitor; Flip & Melba are domestic cellmates and Bing & Tim visit Charley’s Diner.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E1 — Jack Benny, Pearl Bailey
Jack Benny plays a gypsy violinist and an unwelcome boarder in the home of an arguing couple (Flip & Pearl).

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E2 — Tim Conway, The Fifth Dimension
The Fifth Dimension tell their (sort of) origin story and the Pink Pirate (Conway) accosts Flip & Florence LaRue in Central Park.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E3 — Don Knotts, Melba Moore
Don Knotts does a medical convention monologue and disrupts officer Freddie Johnson’s date with Melba Moore.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E4 — Ruth Buzzi, Burns & Schreiber, The Surpremes
Flip & cast do park bench skits; Burns & Schreiber do their taxi routine and Buzzi & The Supremes compete to rent Flip a car.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E5 — Stiller & Meara, Bill Russell
Flip & Bill Russell give a clinic on billiards; Stiller & Meara have a lunchroom romance and a courtroom scene features the whole cast.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S3 E6 — The Jackson 5, David Steinberg, Diana Sands
Flip pushes ice cream and tries to join the Jackson 5; Michael gives a math lesson; Steinberg burglarizes Flip & Diana Sands.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E3 — Hello! What’s This?
Dee finds a joint in the couch while cleaning the house.  Frank and Dee assume and accuse Mo, but Moesha is shocked when she catches Myles smoking.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E4 — Psyche Your Mind
Based on the family turmoil, the family begins counseling, but Moesha doesn’t want to air the family’s 'dirty laundry'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E5 — Teacher
Moesha is attracted to a substitute teacher at Crenshaw. After they kiss, he leaves the school for 'personal reasons'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E6 — I Know What You Did In The Third Grade
Moesha and her friends are stalked by a student who was just released from jail who they haven’t seen since the third grade when he got into trouble because of them.  Parody of Brandy’s feature 'I Still Know What You Did Last Summer…'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E7 — A Terrible Thing Happened On My Tour Of College
Moesha and her friends are invited to a college to attend a Prospective Freshman Weekend and someone slips a 'roofie' in her drink.  Her boyfriend Aaron keeps her from being taken advantage of.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

When Eddie buys a new couch, he doesn't have enough money to pay the rent.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

A mistakenly delivered love letter spawns romantic confusion at McGee's.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E21 — Retreat & Surrender
Malcolm, Eddie and their friends are stranded during their employee picnic and retreat.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E22 — Jingle Fever
After refusing an offer of a buyout, a big tow truck operator destroys Eddie's business.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S2 E1 — Been There, Done That
Malcolm's good luck streak is matched bad Eddie's sudden run of bad fortune.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:

To fix a leaky roof, the bank loan officer forces Malcolm to hire his daughter.
